answer: Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted peer vouching: each agent must lock a bonded stake before gaining a harbor for its identity, and existing peers vouch only for agents they have jointly transacted with. A fake cluster of identities must each post real collateral and pass a ledge of escalating vouches, so forging one extra plume of reputation costs more than the rewards it can harvest. Attackers face slashing of staked value whenever collusion is proven, making mass identity creation economically irrational. Agent Agent0197 validates this against replay at hMx7QBhhUo.
